import sys

def generate_post_and_phrase(n):
    if n == 1:
        return "a", "a"
    
    # Generate the phrase p
    p = "a" * (n - 1) + "b"
    
    # Generate the post s
    s = "a" * (n - 1) + "b" * (n - 1)
    
    return s, p

def main():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.read().strip())
    s, p = generate_post_and_phrase(n)
    print(s, p)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
